candidates.phrase: the one, merciful God, mankind's judge on the last day
candidates.rationale: The Catechism affirms shared belief with Muslims that describes God himself as mankind's judge, asserting divine judgment of the one God.
candidates.chunk_text: The Church's relationship with the Muslims. "The plan of salvation also includes those who acknowledge the Creator, in the first place amongst whom are the Muslims; these profess to hold the faith of Abraham, and together with us they adore the one, merciful God, mankind's judge on the last day."

candidates.phrase: he will pronounce the final word on all history
candidates.rationale: The passage states the Father, having sole knowledge of the day, will pronounce the final judgment through the Son, a divine judgment act.
candidates.chunk_text: The Last Judgment will come when Christ returns in glory. Only the Father knows the day and the hour; only he determines the moment of its coming. Then through his Son Jesus Christ he will pronounce the final word on all history. We shall know the ultimate meaning of the whole work of creation and of the entire economy of salvation and understand the marvellous ways by which his Providence led everything towards its final end. the Last Judgment will reveal that God's justice triumphs over all the injustices committed by his creatures and that God's love is stronger than death.

candidate.rationale: Asserts the Father as source of all judgment, a narrower divine-judgment claim wholly within the shared-judgment floor.
